title: StarRocks scale-out: drain + re-add a BE (ALTER SYSTEM)
description: The nexus-cli scale-out verb for StarRocks (add/remove a NODE -- horizontal). DECOMMISSION a BE so its tablets migrate to the survivors, confirm queries still serve, then re-add it (ALTER SYSTEM ADD BACKEND) and watch tablets re-balance. The add-a-brand-new-BE path is the same ALTER SYSTEM ADD BACKEND plus a new VM clone + foundation reservation (handbook §1.B).

steps.command: ssh -i $NEXUS_SSH_KEY nexusadmin@192.168.70.31 "mysql -h 127.0.0.1 -P 9030 -u root -p$SR_ROOT_PW -e \"ALTER SYSTEM DECOMMISSION BACKEND '192.168.10.36:9050'\""

observe.what: sr-be-3 enters DECOMMISSION; its tablets migrate to sr-be-1/2 (TabletNum drains to 0) -- a clean horizontal scale-in

steps.command: ssh -i $NEXUS_SSH_KEY nexusadmin@192.168.70.31 "mysql -h 127.0.0.1 -P 9030 -u root -p$SR_ROOT_PW -N -e 'SELECT count(*) FROM nexus.events'"

observe.what: queries still serve full results during/after the drain (replicas on the survivors)

steps.command: ssh -i $NEXUS_SSH_KEY nexusadmin@192.168.70.31 "mysql -h 127.0.0.1 -P 9030 -u root -p$SR_ROOT_PW -e \"ALTER SYSTEM ADD BACKEND '192.168.10.36:9050'\""

observe.what: sr-be-3 re-joins Alive=true; the FE tablet scheduler re-balances tablets back onto it (scale-out)

whatProves: scale-out/in is a clean cluster-membership change: a BE can be DECOMMISSIONed (tablets migrate to survivors) and re-added (tablets re-balance) with no data loss + no query interruption. ALTER SYSTEM ADD/DECOMMISSION BACKEND is the node add/remove primitive.
